page.overview:
What is Dagmor?

Dagmor was the name of the sword that belonged to Beren, in the First Age.

As a lone outlaw in Dorthonion, Beren carried Dagmor throughout his many journeys. It is presumably lost after his death.

The name Dagmor may from the Sindarin words dag ("slay") and môr ("dark, darkness").

The sword's name was not mentioned in ; it is only mentioned in The Lay of Leithian in .
